1706.title: Queued message visibility and recovery
1706.rootCauseConfidence: High for tested claimed-row visibility/persistence/recovery; permanent loss unproven
1706.rootCauseOneLine: Claimed rows remain durable but are excluded from queue lists; stale release and actual idle recovery retain the synthetic payload in a durable turn request.
1706.proposedFix: Expose claimed/sending queue state and durable handoff receipts; retain ownership fencing during recovery.
1706.caveats: Two same-agent clean runs. SQLite reopen and server recovery tested separately; no live process crash, CLI/log/UI/provider execution or historical fleet incident verification. Historical evidence preserved.
